authored: eng7-l12: living futures require not sacrifice or an existing earned Commander return; bereavement alternatives preserve historical costs. Applies to every sibling ending, including mourning and allowlisted pages.

continuations.prefix: The spring after Threshold, somebody knocked
continuations.bereavement: The spring after Threshold, Anevia carried her lantern to the memorial. She knocked three times against the stone, swore at herself, and stayed until the oil ran out.

continuations.prefix: Irabeth came with her, carrying both
continuations.bereavement: Irabeth came with her, carrying oil for the lantern. Neither woman asked the other to leave.

continuations.prefix: She kept to the door rule for the rest
continuations.bereavement: Before Threshold she had made the Commander keep the door rule: a real door, three knocks, and no furniture. Afterwards she kept it herself. Nobody else was given the key.

continuations.prefix: Beth stayed dead. Anevia kept her side of the bed
continuations.bereavement: Beth stayed dead. Then the Commander died at Threshold. Anevia kept both names, and told anyone who tried to make one loss smaller than the other to go to hell.

continuations.prefix: She never forgave the Commander for Iz
continuations.bereavement: Threshold did not pay the debt from Iz. She laid flowers at Beth's grave, and a lantern at the Commander's, and would let nobody call either debt settled.

continuations.prefix: She kept her word and never came inside. Letters reached
continuations.bereavement: She kept her word and never came inside. After Threshold she carried one unsigned letter south with her, and never sent it.

continuations.prefix: She and the Commander stayed on their own sides
continuations.bereavement: Before Threshold they had stayed on their own sides of the line in the mud, by agreement. Anevia remembered it as one of the few lines the Commander had kept.

continuations.prefix: When the Wound closed, Irabeth Tirabade put her sword down at last, flexed
continuations.bereavement: Irabeth put her sword down after Threshold. The question she had saved for the Commander went unanswered.

continuations.prefix: After Threshold, Irabeth Tirabade put her sword down at last, flexed
continuations.bereavement: Irabeth put her sword down after Threshold. The question she had saved for the Commander went unanswered.

continuations.prefix: When the Wound closed, Irabeth Tirabade put her sword down at last, walked
continuations.bereavement: After Threshold Irabeth walked out to her wife on the road side of the gate. They went home together. There was no third answer to bring back.

continuations.prefix: After Threshold, Irabeth Tirabade put her sword down at last, walked
continuations.bereavement: After Threshold Irabeth walked out to her wife on the road side of the gate. They went home together. There was no third answer to bring back.

continuations.prefix: The south-road courier caught her up
continuations.bereavement: The south-road courier caught her after Threshold. She read the answer she had sent him for and folded it away. It had come too late.
